meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 它从代码库中提取业务领域、流程和步骤，生成可交互的横向流程图展示在仪表盘。已有知识图谱就直接基于它生成，否则先做轻量文件扫描。
howto.when: 当你想梳理代码库的业务领域/流程，或发出 /understand-domain 时启动。默认复用已有知识图谱，否则会做轻量扫描；加 --full 会强制重新扫描。

say.text: 请提取这个项目里的业务领域和主要流程。
say.note: 会开始扫描并生成领域流程图。

say.text: 用 /understand-domain 梳理代码库并显示流程图。
say.note: 直接调用该技能，在仪表盘查看结果。

say.text: 已有知识图谱时，直接基于它生成领域图。
say.note: 有图谱时跳过扫描，直接复用。

howto.what_en: It extracts business domains, flows, and process steps from a codebase and shows an interactive horizontal flow graph on the dashboard. If a knowledge graph already exists it derives from it; otherwise it does a lightweight file scan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to inspect a codebase's business domains/flows or run /understand-domain. It reuses an existing knowledge graph when present; otherwise scans files. Use --full to force a rescan.

say_en.text: Please extract the business domains and main flows from this project.
say_en.note: It scans and produces the domain flow graph.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain to map the codebase and display the flow graph.
say_en.note: Directly invokes the skill and shows the dashboard.

say_en.text: If a knowledge graph exists, generate the domain graph from it.
say_en.note: Skips scanning and reuses the existing graph.
